title: Loop of the Recursive Dragon — Computing Concepts, Chapters 7-9: Algorithms, Software Engineering & Databases
intro_html:
A free quiz-RPG for an introductory computing course, chapters 7-9: Algorithms, Software Engineering & Databases. Battle monsters by answering questions about searching, sorting and Big-O notation, software engineering with git and AI-assisted development, and databases and the relational model.

Pick a set below to begin. Your progress is recorded in this course's gradebook.
